description:
[Trading Data API] Real-time web search for agents: ranked results with title, URL, snippet and score, plus an optional synthesized answer. Pay per search; general or news topic.

**Example:** `/v1/web-search?q=latest+ethereum+upgrade&max_results=5&topic=news`

Use when an agent needs fresh web results with titles, URLs and snippets. Not for verifying a claim (use sanity_check with mode open).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

include_answer.description: Optional. true (default) or false to skip the synthesized answer.

name: web_search
